inputs.text: They're pushing this new gun control bill in New York as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, claiming it forces guns sold there to be built so they can't be easily modified into illegal machine guns, plus criminal penalties for whatever they claim. But this is obviously just another coordinated move by the hidden elites to disarm regular people step by step. The official line about stopping modifications is pure manipulation—they're using it as cover to expand control, criminalize ownership further, and make sure only the powerful stay armed while the rest of us get boxed in. Don't fall for it; this is all about narrative control and preventing any real pushback against their agenda.
